bio.title: Bio
bio.bio1: I'm a young and motivated developer, currently working and always learning. Although my experience is still growing, I've already had the chance to work on real-world projects that have challenged me and helped me grow quickly.
bio.bio2: Based in the EU, I love to travel and play video games in my free time. My passion for technology keeps me motivated to improve every day, and I'm excited for the opportunities ahead.
